title: The drawn null
direction: Symbol + wordmark: a heavy, drawn monospace zero whose slash is a negative-space cut, with a worked JetBrains Mono word
rationale: Developers know the slashed zero as the character that cannot be mistaken; MacNull's promise is the same exactness about what gets emptied

pitch.idea: A zero struck with a backslash: \0, the null character developers know, which is also the N of MacNull drawn as one heavy solid form; every free terminal of the word is cut on the same backslash angle.
strengths: The symbol says null in a developer's own notation and doubles as an N, so it is ownable without being a lone initial
One angle runs through symbol and word, so the system reads as built, not assembled
Heavy filled silhouette holds up as an app icon on an ink tile and at 16 px
weaknesses: The narrow blade counters close up around 16 px and the mark reads as a plain dark pill
Some will first read the symbol as an N in a rounded box rather than a zero
The faceted terminals vanish below about 24 px, so the small word is close to stock JetBrains Mono
